vsm1.4:180.1: Evamadhigate pana tasmiṃpi vuttanayeneva pañcahākārehi ciṇṇavasinā hutvā paguṇatatiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya
vsm1.4:180.2: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannapītipaccatthikā, ‘yadeva tattha sukhamiti cetaso ābhogo, etenetaṃ oḷārikaṃ akkhāyatī’ti (dī. ni. 1.96)
vsm1.4:180.3: evaṃ vuttassa sukhassa oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca
vsm1.4:180.4: tattha dosaṃ disvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ santato manasikatvā
vsm1.4:180.5: tatiyajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya catutthādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.
vsm1.4:181.1: Athassa yadā tatiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato
vsm1.4:181.2: cetasikasomanassasaṅkhātaṃ sukhaṃ oḷārikato upaṭṭhāti, upekkhāvedanā ceva cittekaggatā ca santato upaṭṭhāti, tadāssa oḷārikaṅgappahānāya santaaṅgapaṭilābhāya ca
vsm1.4:181.3: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto ‘‘idāni catutthaṃ jhānaṃ uppajjissatī’’ti
vsm1.4:181.4: bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā tadeva pathavīkasiṇaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjanaṃ uppajjati.
vsm1.4:181.5: Tato tasmiṃyevārammaṇe cattāri pañca vā javanāni uppajjanti,
vsm1.4:182.1: Ayaṃ pana viseso, yasmā sukhavedanā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya āsevanapaccayena paccayo na hoti,
vsm1.4:183.1: Ettāvatā cesa sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā
vsm1.4:183.3: adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati (dī. ni. 1.232; dha. sa. 165).
vsm1.4:183.5: tividhakalyāṇaṃ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇaṃ.
vsm1.4:184.1: Tattha sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānāti kāyikasukhassa ca kāyikadukkhassa ca pahānā.
vsm1.4:184.2: Pubbevāti tañca kho pubbeva, na catutthajjhānakkhaṇe.
vsm1.4:184.3: Somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāti cetasikasukhassa ca cetasikadukkhassa cāti imesampi dvinnaṃ
vsm1.4:184.4: pubbeva atthaṅgamā, pahānā icceva vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:185.6: indriyavibhaṅge pana indriyānaṃ uddesakkameneva idhāpi vuttānaṃ sukhadukkhasomanassadomanassānaṃ pahānaṃ veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:186.1: Yadi panetāni tassa tassa jhānassa upacārakkhaṇeyeva pahīyanti,
vsm1.4:186.2: atha kasmā ‘‘kattha cuppannaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati,
vsm1.4:186.3: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehipi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
vsm1.4:186.5: Kattha cuppannaṃ domanassindriyaṃ sukhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati,
vsm1.4:186.6: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
vsm1.4:186.7: ettha cuppannaṃ somanassindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.510) evaṃ jhānesveva nirodho vuttoti?
vsm1.4:186.9: Atisayanirodho hi nesaṃ paṭhamajjhānādīsu, na nirodhoyeva.
vsm1.4:187.3: visamāsanupatāpena vā siyā uppatti, na tveva antoappanāyaṃ.
vsm1.4:187.4: Upacāre vā niruddhampetaṃ na suṭṭhu niruddhaṃ hoti, paṭipakkhena avihatattā.
vsm1.4:187.5: Antoappanāyaṃ pana pītipharaṇena sabbo kāyo sukhokkanto hoti,
vsm1.4:187.6: sukhokkantakāyassa ca suṭṭhu niruddhaṃ hoti dukkhindriyaṃ, paṭipakkhena vihatattā.
vsm1.4:188.2: yasmā etaṃ vitakkavicārapaccayepi kāyakilamathe cittupaghāte ca sati uppajjati.
vsm1.4:188.4: Yattha pana uppajjati, tattha vitakkavicārabhāve, appahīnā eva ca dutiyajjhānupacāre vitakkavicārāti
vsm1.4:188.5: tatthassa siyā uppatti, na tveva dutiyajjhāne, pahīnapaccayattā.
vsm1.4:189.4: Tatiyajjhāne hi sukhassa paccayabhūtā pīti sabbaso niruddhāti.
vsm1.4:189.6: āsannattā appanāppattāya upekkhāya abhāvena sammā anatikkantattā ca siyā uppatti,
vsm1.4:189.8: Tasmā eva ca etthuppannaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhatīti
vsm1.4:190.1: Etthāha ‘‘athevaṃ tassa tassa jhānassupacāre pahīnāpi etā vedanā idha kasmā samāhaṭā’’ti?
vsm1.4:190.3: Yā hi ayaṃ adukkhamasukhanti ettha adukkhamasukhā vedanā vuttā,
vsm1.4:190.4: sā sukhumā duviññeyyā na sakkā sukhena gahetuṃ,
vsm1.4:190.5: tasmā yathā nāma duṭṭhassa yathā vā tathā vā upasaṅkamitvā gahetuṃ asakkuṇeyyassa goṇassa
vsm1.4:190.6: sukhaggahaṇatthaṃ gopo ekasmiṃ vaje sabbā gāvo samāharati,
vsm1.4:190.8: ‘‘ayaṃ so gaṇhatha na’’nti tampi gāhayati, evameva bhagavā sukhaggahaṇatthaṃ sabbā etā samāhari.
vsm1.4:190.9: Evañhi samāhaṭā etā dassetvā yaṃ neva sukhaṃ na dukkhaṃ na somanassaṃ na domanassaṃ,
vsm1.4:190.10: ayaṃ adukkhamasukhā vedanāti sakkā hoti esā gāhayituṃ.
vsm1.4:191.1: Apica adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā paccayadassanatthañcāpi etā vuttāti veditabbā.
vsm1.4:191.3: Yathāha – ‘‘cattāro kho, āvuso, paccayā adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā.
vsm1.4:191.4: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
vsm1.4:191.5: Ime khvāvuso, cattāro paccayā adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458).
vsm1.4:192.1: Yathā vā aññattha pahīnāpi sakkāyadiṭṭhiādayo tatiyamaggassa vaṇṇabhaṇanatthaṃ tattha pahīnāti vuttā,
vsm1.4:192.2: evaṃ vaṇṇabhaṇanatthampetassa jhānassetā idha vuttātipi veditabbā.
vsm1.4:192.5: Etāsu hi sukhaṃ somanassassa paccayo, somanassaṃ rāgassa.
vsm1.4:192.7: Sukhādighātena cassa sappaccayā rāgadosā hatāti atidūre hontīti.
vsm1.4:194.2: Imasmiñhi jhāne suparisuddhā sati, yā ca tassā satiyā pārisuddhi, sā upekkhāya katā, na aññena.
vsm1.4:194.4: Vibhaṅgepi vuttaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ sati imāya upekkhāya visadā hoti parisuddhā pariyodātā.
vsm1.4:194.6: Yāya ca upekkhāya ettha satiyā pārisuddhi hoti, sā atthato tatramajjhattatātiveditabbā.
vsm1.4:194.7: Na kevalañcettha tāya satiyeva parisuddhā, apica kho sabbepi sampayuttadhammā,
vsm1.4:195.1: Tattha kiñcāpi ayaṃ upekkhā heṭṭhāpi tīsu jhānesu vijjati.
vsm1.4:195.2: Yathā pana divā sūriyappabhābhibhavā sommabhāvena ca attano upakārakattena vā sabhāgāya rattiyā alābhā divā vijjamānāpi candalekhā aparisuddhā hoti apariyodātā,
vsm1.4:195.3: evamayampi tatramajjhattupekkhācandalekhā vitakkādipaccanīkadhammatejābhibhavā sabhāgāya ca upekkhāvedanārattiyā appaṭilābhā vijjamānāpi paṭhamādijjhānabhedesu aparisuddhā hoti.
vsm1.4:195.5: divā aparisuddhacandalekhāya pabhā viya sahajātāpi satiādayo aparisuddhāva honti.
vsm1.4:195.7: Idha pana vitakkādipaccanīkadhammatejābhibhavābhāvā sabhāgāya ca upekkhāvedanārattiyā paṭilābhā ayaṃ tatramajjhattupekkhācandalekhā ativiya parisuddhā.
vsm1.4:195.9: parisuddhacandalekhāya pabhā viya sahajātāpi satiādayo parisuddhā honti pariyodātā.
vsm1.4:197.3: Tañca pana somanassaṃ ekavīthiyaṃ purimajavanesuyeva pahīyati.
vsm1.4:197.5: Upekkhāvedanā cittassekaggatāti imesaṃ pana dvinnaṃ uppattivasena duvaṅgasamannāgatatā veditabbā.
vsm1.4:198.2: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannanīvaraṇapaccatthikā, vitakkassa oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca
vsm1.4:198.3: tattha dosaṃ disvā dutiyajjhānaṃ santato manasikaritvā
vsm1.4:198.4: paṭhamajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya dutiyādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.
vsm1.4:199.1: Athassa yadā paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa
vsm1.4:199.2: jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato vitakkamattaṃ oḷārikato upaṭṭhāti, vicārādayo santato.
vsm1.4:199.4: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto vuttanayeneva dutiyajjhānaṃ uppajjati.
vsm1.4:200.1: Evamadhigate pana tasmimpi vuttanayeneva pañcahākārehi ciṇṇavasinā hutvā paguṇadutiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya
vsm1.4:200.2: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannavitakkapaccatthikā, vicārassa oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca
vsm1.4:200.3: tattha dosaṃ disvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ santato manasikaritvā
vsm1.4:200.4: dutiyajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya tatiyādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.
vsm1.4:201.1: Athassa yadā dutiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa
vsm1.4:201.2: jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato vicāramattaṃ oḷārikato upaṭṭhāti, pītiādīni santato.
vsm1.4:201.4: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto vuttanayeneva tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ uppajjati.
vsm1.4:201.6: catukkanayassa dutiyajjhāne viya pītiādīni tīṇi samannāgataṅgāni.
vsm1.4:202.2: taṃ dvidhā bhinditvā pañcakanaye dutiyañceva tatiyañca hoti.
vsm1.4:202.3: Yāni ca tattha tatiyacatutthāni, tāni ca catutthapañcamāni honti.
vsm1.4:202.5: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Samādhibhāvanādhikāre Pathavīkasiṇaniddeso nāma Catuttho paricchedo.
